text_block_list.text:
—I heard a certain rumor.
That there was a "hidden genius" in one of the classes.
Peeking quietly into the classroom...

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Fusaichi Pandora-san, 84 points!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heheh~♪ How's that, huh? How's that?
I'm truly something else!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Fusaichi Pandora-san, 86 points!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Chu-chu-wah, chu-chu-wah♡
Well, that one was a total breeze anyway~♪

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Fusaichi Pandora-san, 82 points!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
'Sup, 'sup♪
It was a bit tricky, but hey, totally fine♡

Perhaps she's not a natural genius... but rather a prodigy through hard work.
Proof being, she doesn't get perfect scores in every single subject.
Even so, she must be quite smart. Intrigued, I decided to listen to what she had to say...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No, but look, before those three tests,
I had zero motivation to study at all~.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: And every single one scored above an 80, which is totally wild☆ Am I just too talented or what~?!

I see. Scoring that high without studying is certainly impressive.
Then as a test, for the next exam――
choice_data_list: Let's prepare thoroughly and give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Prepare properly...? Ugh, isn't that a drag?
I don't really gotta do all that~.
choice_data_list: Don't you want to test that dormant power?
Don't you want to test that dormant power?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, now that you mention it...
Guess I'll give it a shot, just once.
And the result of the test given my absolute all was――

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, the results from the other day came out♪
Look, look!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: 82 points!
choice_data_list: Huh... But I gave it everything I had. Why?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Welp, I tried giving studying my all for like 15 minutes,
but not much really changed, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Still, at that pace, if I'd done eight hours,
I totally would've scored 100%. Not that I'm gonna♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Cramming...? Ah, you mean studying only the night before?
Doing that once in a while might actually be kinda fun!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll give it a shot. Better stock up on
a ton of milk tea so I don't doze off.
And the result of the test pulled off via an all-nighter was――

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, the results from the other day came out♪
Look, look!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: 82 points!
choice_data_list: Huh... But I pulled an all-nighter for this. Why?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Man, the second I thought 'don't fall asleep,' it just made me drowsier, and next thing I knew I was out cold.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A little milk tea isn't gonna stop how sleepy I am ♡
Maybe I'll go with lemon tea next.
